en.title: Maximum Final Value After Deleting and Merging Neighbors
en.description:
Each operation deletes one element: if it is at an end, it is simply deleted; if it is in the middle, it is deleted and its left and right neighbors are merged into their sum. Exactly one element must remain at the end; maximize the final value.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; bounds supplemented where the source lacks them and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the specification.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains n integers. The original n≤100000 and −10^9≤a[i]≤10^9 are kept; this site specifies n≥1, and the final result cannot be an empty array.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: -2; 4; 0. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Sum the positive numbers at the original odd indices and at the original even indices separately and take the larger sum; if there are no positive numbers, take the maximum of the original array.
